text:
maria: FYI AcmeSys asked for a joint perf/W + throughput sweep on their Ampere2 boards next Tue-Wed. They want a short writeup for marketplace listing + a co-announcement. Can we lock scope?
kevin: thanks. what models and seq lengths are we running? also need expected concurrency targets.
jihoon: recommend running gpt-2-medium / gpt-neo-1.3B and a trimmed Llama-2-7B variant. seq: 512 and 2048, bs sweep 1,2,4,8. capture kv-cache hit rates.
maria: they suggested 2048 is the headline number, but want the 512 run for baseline. concurrency: 1-16.
sara: from product/marketplace POV we need a short set of validated numbers + approved logo/artifacts. embargo until joint PR. timeline?
kevin: engineering can do dry run Mon, full sweep Tue-Wed. need access to partner power telemetry and kernel debug symbols. who owns the power logs?
maria: Acme will provide IPMI + external power meter CSVs. they asked us to avoid posting raw CSVs publicly.
jihoon: note: we have a kernel micro-op patch that improves fused-attn throughput on Ampere2. partner needs to sign an NDA addendum to accept kernel changes for the public benchmark.
sara: NDA addendum ok. legal will handle. we need a one-paragraph blurb for the marketplace tile by EOD Fri.
devon: bench-bot here — I created a job template: job/bench-ampere2-2024-03. Config: `model_suite: [gpt2m,gptneo,llama2-7b-trim] seq:[512,2048] bs:[1,2,4,8] concurrency:[1,4,8,16] power_log: /artifacts/power/$JOB_ID.csv`.
kevin: devon — can we include kernel flag `--use-fused-attn=true` as an opt-in? need ability to toggle for A/B.
devon: yes. template has `kernel_flags: ["fused_attn=true","quantize_int8=false"]` and supports `--toggle-variant` to run both.
jihoon: also request we collect per-token p99 latency and tail power draw samples (100ms buckets). script snippet: `./run_bench --model $M --seq $S --bs $B --out /artifacts/$JOB_ID --power /mnt/power --collect-tail-ms 100`
maria: blocking items: (1) partner signs NDA addendum (2) legal OK on embargo wording (3) infra creds for Acme to retrieve artifacts (4) final blurb for marketplace.
sara: I'll draft blurb and embargo language. legal pinged @legal-team.
kevin: infra — grant Acme read-only S3 bucket and pre-signed link for power logs only. I can provision by Mon morning.
jihoon: one more: dataset+prompt seed must be included in appendix so numbers are reproducible. we should standardize prompt sets used.
maria: we'll share the seed list. final ask — can eng-runtime produce a short per-route throughput graph for the console? that'll help the marketplace tile.
kevin: yes, we can produce 1-page perf card with graphs (throughput vs power). deliverable Tue evening.
sara: plan looks good. I'll collate deliverables and set a sync Mon 10am. :calendar:
bench-bot: job/bench-ampere2-2024-03 created and scheduled for 2024-03-12 08:00 UTC. Logs will stream to /artifacts/bench-ampere2-2024-03/logs.
maria: thanks everyone — tagging this ticket RED-457 for tracking. we'll share the draft marketplace text in this thread when ready.
